name: Militia Ore Loop 2
about: The ore loop (factory-generator.md phase 1): Militia Extraction Post 2 over a deposit, Militia Refinery 2 downstream on the same road line, an Ore Hauler under the post's loading skip. Flip LOAD on the skip's post, drive east along the road to the refinery's Tipping Bunker (the bunker on your left, your left wheels along its edge) and flip TIP behind the cab.

bodies.note: over the deposit, its drills along the back edge
its bed's middle, facing east, under the loading skip
